success_criteria: Plan gate object is complete and passes deterministic validation.
Implementation scope is limited to allowed skill files.
Verification evidence is known before dispatch.

manual_checks: Confirm universal wording uses roles, not concrete workers
evidence_expected: boundary grep shows no concrete adapter worker names

dispatch_decision.reason: Plan is bounded, verifiable, and role-based.
